text: Bonsoir Yacino I would like to say that the specifications are 86-66-91 (Cindy Crawford, what else?) but that would be inappropriate and uncorrect. A flag limit is what happens when the price breaks a flag, retrace and is rejected. This zone (breaks-retrace-rejection ) is where it has been decided to break the flag. When price comes back to it (FTB) it is likely to be rejected again.
